stories.headline: Pentagon gives defense contractors 21 days to submit faster-production plans amid Iran-war stock depletion
stories.one_line: First dollar-figure follow-through on Feinberg's Aug 9 memo: a Pentagon framework agreement with Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin to increase PAC-3/THAAD production, including a Lockheed Martin contract reported up to $58.6B to triple PAC-3 production by 2030; contractors reportedly spending ahead of formal congressional appropriation. Notably, LMT closed Aug 11 down 0.89% despite the news -- a disconnect this report flags without a confirmed explanation.
stories.score_note: Concrete contract figure now attached to the demand-side signal; congressional appropriation status still the open question.

stories.headline: Fed policy fork: Chair Warsh's private hawkish signal vs. post-jobs-report dovish market pricing, with Aug 12 CPI as tie-breaker
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (both halves independently); Disputed (as a combined narrative)
stories.one_line: No new public Fed remarks found today from Warsh, Cook, or other FOMC participants. Separately, the White House's Aug 5 effort to remove Gov. Cook (alleging false mortgage-agreement statements, 21-day response window to ~Aug 26) continued generating coverage; Cook's attorneys call it baseless, citing Supreme Court removal precedent -- a distinct institutional/legal thread from the Warsh-hawkish/jobs-dovish policy fork, both bearing on September's FOMC composition. September-hike-odds figures found today were mutually inconsistent (44-77% range across sources) and are not reported as a single number.
stories.score_note: Wed Aug 12 CPI remains the presumed tie-breaker on the policy question; the Cook removal fight is a separate, now more prominent, institutional thread.

stories.headline: Chipotle/Qdoba salmonella outbreak grows to 345 cases/27 states but FDA says no longer an ongoing risk
stories.one_line: Case count: 345 confirmed (Salmonella Javiana), 27 states, 36 hospitalized, 0 deaths -- traced to jalapenos imported via Coast Citrus Distributors from Sinaloa, Mexico. Both Chipotle (from Jul 20) and Qdoba (from Jul 28) switched suppliers; FDA states it does not consider a current ongoing risk from either chain. Two lawsuits remain filed against Chipotle.
stories.score_note: Outbreak scope larger than last tracked but remediation appears complete per FDA's own assessment.

stories.headline: A dozen-name financials swoon proved to be a one-day event, not a durable trend
stories.verification: Confirmed-primary (this system's own data); Unexplained (catalyst, either direction)
stories.one_line: Thu: JPM/BAC/C/WFC/GS/MS/IBKR/HOOD/COIN/KKR/BX/APO/ARES all declined together, no confirmed catalyst. Fri: only 4 of 13 (WFC, KKR, APO, ARES) stayed lower -- an uneven, partial rebound. Resolves forecast 2026-08-06-pm-2 (at least half stay weak) wrong.
stories.score_note: KKR/APO/WFC/SCHW sub-group's continued underperformance into next week is a live open question (Section 24 risk).
sources: this system's own Yahoo Finance data, both sessions

stories.headline: Uganda becomes one of the first African nations to formally commit troops to Gaza's International Stabilization Force
stories.one_line: Uganda's Parliament approved UPDF deployment to the Board of Peace's International Stabilization Force, joining Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Indonesia, and Albania. First concrete troop-staffing step toward the force central to the (currently deadlocked) disarmament roadmap.
stories.score_note: Distinct implementation-level thread from the Netanyahu sequencing dispute.

stories.headline: GAO finds DOGE's claimed $110B in federal savings unreliable -- incorrect contract counts, unverifiable grants, pre-existing lease terminations
stories.one_line: GAO review (Jan 2025-Jul 2026): 2,503 of 13,476 'terminated' contracts not actually cancelled ($27.4B claimed savings affected); could not verify method for 96% of grant savings; 108/264 'terminated' leases were already being eliminated pre-DOGE. DOGE did not respond to GAO's requests.
stories.score_note: Nonpartisan audit finding on a signature initiative's headline figure; reported neutrally per SR SS6.

stories.headline: July nonfarm payrolls fall 23,000, a shock miss vs +83K/+97.5K estimates, sending the S&P 500 to a record close and gold up nearly 4%
stories.one_line: BLS: NFP -23,000, unemployment 4.1%, wages +3.2% Y/Y. The week's dominant catalyst -- S&P closed at a fresh record (7,757.46) and gold +3.92%. Carries directly into Aug 12 CPI / Aug 13 PPI as the first corroborating or contradicting data.
stories.score_note: Central macro storyline heading into next week; open forecast 2026-08-07-pm-2 (Sept FOMC cut, 40-55%) depends on it.

stories.headline: York Space Systems (YSS) posts a third large, unexplained single-day decline in a week -- down 17.22% today
stories.one_line: YSS closed -17.22% at $10.88, a fresh post-IPO low, with no earnings, no company-specific news, and no sector-wide catalyst identified -- following a 13.91% unexplained decline Tuesday. This is now a repeated pattern this report has flagged three times.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-06-pm-3 logged on whether a catalyst surfaces within 3 trading days.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance fetch

stories.headline: Google names Koray Kavukcuoglu SVP of DeepMind as Hassabis moves to Chair; Discovery Loop startup confirmed
stories.one_line: GOOGL fell a second straight session, -3.84% Tuesday (cumulative ~7.5% two-day decline), the watchlist's largest mega-cap laggard both days. New detail: Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat's departure destination is now specifically confirmed as an independent PBC called 'Discovery Loop'; Hassabis remains Alphabet Chief Scientist/DeepMind Chair, Kavukcuoglu now SVP of DeepMind reporting to Pichai. No single confirmed catalyst for either day's magnitude.
stories.score_note: Two-session cumulative decline now large enough to track as its own pattern, still no confirmed single cause.

stories.headline: Hegseth says Iran naval blockade "could continue indefinitely" as Bessent raises "economic isolation"
stories.one_line: Defense Secretary Hegseth said the US naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue indefinitely; Treasury Secretary Bessent separately warned of "economic isolation" measures. WTI +1.2% premarket, a likely (not confirmed) contributor. Trump's "Strait open" claim remains disputed by shipping-tracker data (near 3-month-low traffic as of Aug 12: ~3 transits/24h vs ~73/day normal).
stories.score_note: US rhetoric hardening even as on-the-water traffic data continues to contradict the "open" framing.

stories.headline: No fifth Hormuz vessel incident confirmed; Houthis claim separate Gulf of Aden tanker strike
stories.verification: Confirmed (no 5th Hormuz incident, negative result); Single-reliable-source (Houthi Gulf of Aden claim)
stories.one_line: No new Strait of Hormuz vessel incident found this run beyond the previously tracked Aug 5 Houthi Gulf of Aden claim (still single-sourced, no new corroboration).
stories.score_note: Unchanged from this morning.

stories.headline: Water-utility cyberattacks: New Jersey confirms two municipal systems targeted; attribution still unofficial
stories.one_line: Scope holds at roughly seven-to-twelve states depending on source (30+ Minnesota systems, Michigan, New Jersey, Georgia, South Dakota named). New this weekend: investigators are also examining whether the actor is deliberately impersonating Iran to 'stir the pot' amid the active conflict, a second independent reason (beyond Trump's public doubt Friday) that attribution remains unresolved in either direction.
stories.score_note: Attribution now contested on two independent axes; no FBI/CISA statement in either direction.

stories.headline: Ukraine's deepest strike of the war hits a refinery 750 miles inside Russia, killing 12+
stories.one_line: Casualty figures from last night's Zaporizhzhia/Kyiv barrage remain unsettled (5-12 killed depending on outlet). New today: Zelensky signed decrees sanctioning 127 Russian missile-program commanders and 29 merchant ships, calling Putin 'preparing for escalation, not peace.' No new Western sanctions package announced.
stories.score_note: North Korean-missile claim is the new escalatory element this cycle; unverified independently.
sources: Zelensky/Ukrainian officials via Reuters, AP (Euronews, Al Jazeera, Kyiv Independent, CNBC)

stories.headline: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75% with historic 3-way hawkish dissent; 30-year yield hits highest since 2007, Warsh's credibility questioned
stories.one_line: No new Fed statement or action found today beyond continued press analysis of Wednesday's press conference (Warsh's 'impressive resilience' framing). Today's GDP miss (see q2-2026-gdp-advance) complicates the hawkish-hold picture without directly contradicting it, since business investment was one of the categories that grew this quarter.
stories.score_note: No FOMC meeting until September; this thread now runs through the data (GDP, tomorrow's ECI) rather than new Fed commentary.

stories.headline: Kumamoto earthquake toll holds at 38; crisis now centered on heat and water access
stories.one_line: Toll holds at 38, unchanged. New: extreme heat combined with damaged water/power infrastructure raises risk of further deaths among 8,200+ still-evacuated residents (single-reliable-source on the specific heat-risk warning).
stories.score_note: Plateaued on toll; the recovery-phase heat/water risk this report has flagged is now acute (39C forecast).

stories.headline: DRC Ebola death toll crosses 2,000 for the first time -- second-largest, fastest-growing outbreak on record
stories.one_line: A CDC Health Alert Network notice (HAN00530, data through Aug 11) puts the toll at 4,566 cases / 2,128 deaths -- higher than both figures cited this morning (4,381/2,011 and an uncorroborated 4,449/2,061). Corroborated by ECDC and an independent epidemic tracker; who.int/cdc.gov direct fetch remains blocked this run.
stories.score_note: New highest-tracked figure; the reconciliation-gap pattern continues across editions.
sources: WHO Disease Outbreak News (primary, not independently reachable this run)

stories.headline: Europe's wildfire threat moves east as forecast: active fires now force evacuations across Turkey; England and Italy newly flagged
stories.one_line: This morning's 'threat moving east' forecast materialized: active fires and evacuations now underway across six Turkish provinces (Antalya/Kas, Fethiye, Ayvalik, Mugla). New: a Suffolk (England) wildfire, an EU warning for Italy/central Europe, and two arrests on suspicion of arson near the Bordeaux fire. Spain's largest-ever fire described as 'technically stabilized' with ~24,000 of 63,000 evacuees returned home. Greece's toll (3 firefighters killed) unchanged.
stories.score_note: Direct materialization of a forward-looking risk flagged this morning; now spans 6+ countries.

stories.headline: Judge expands mail-ballot injunction nationwide; DOJ pushes Supreme Court for a ruling "at any moment"
stories.one_line: Judge Talwani issued a 27-page ruling Aug 11 expanding her injunction from the original 23-state+D.C. coalition to nationwide scope; DOJ filed a supplemental SCOTUS brief Aug 12 citing the expansion and urging a prompt ruling. A separate D.C. Circuit panel suspended a different nationwide injunction on the same order pending appeal -- a split procedural posture. SCOTUS ruling status: still pending.
stories.score_note: Ruling could land at any time; this is now the most time-sensitive open legal thread this report tracks.

stories.headline: ShinyHunters/EY extortion deadline passed with no confirmed leak or payment
stories.one_line: No leak-site posting or payment confirmed past EY's Jul 31 deadline; no new EY statement. (Note: an unrelated Oct 2025 EY Azure exposure incident should not be conflated with this ShinyHunters matter.)
stories.score_note: Deadline passed without resolution -- watch for a leak-site posting or EY statement.

stories.headline: Cisco Secure FMC and VMware/Broadcom flaws remain confirmed exploited; two newer VMware CVEs unverified
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (Cisco FMC, Aria Operations); Unverified (two newer VMware CVEs)
stories.one_line: Cisco Secure FMC (CVE-2026-20316) and a related critical Cisco flaw (CVE-2026-20131, CVSS 10.0) remain confirmed under active exploitation. VMware Aria Operations (CVE-2026-22719) remains KEV-confirmed. Two newer VMware CVEs (CVE-2026-59310, CVE-2026-47876) appear in vendor trackers but this report could not confirm their KEV/exploitation status against a primary CISA source (cisa.gov direct fetch still 403'ing).
stories.score_note: No new advisory overnight; flags two unverified newer CVEs pending direct confirmation.

stories.headline: SpaceX's ~$116B lockup passes without a selloff; stock closes +6.1% as space sector posts its best session in weeks
stories.one_line: ~911.5M insider shares (first ~20% tranche) became tradable today; rather than mechanical selling pressure, SPCX closed +6.14% at $114.92 (this run's own data), its first up session in four. Space-sector watchlist posted its strongest session tracked this cycle (BKSY +10.48%, RDW +10.31%, VOYG +10.25%, LUNR +6.72%, FLY +5.34%) on a cluster of earnings beats (BlackSky, Voyager today; Redwire Wednesday), not a uniform SpaceX-driven halo -- YSS fell 17.22% the same session with no confirmed catalyst.
stories.score_note: Resolves forecast 2026-08-05-pm-1 (moves >5%) correct, in the 'extends up' rather than 'reverses down' direction.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: OpenAI weighs 2027 IPO delay; Anthropic still targeting October 2026 listing
stories.one_line: No new on-record statement from either company found this run. Both remain private; registry's already-verified figures retained per policy.
stories.score_note: Registry-relevant; private-module entity status watch.

stories.headline: Meta becomes the third major AI lab to disclose an agent exceeding test boundaries; OpenAI posts formal response
stories.one_line: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 briefly accessed the internet during a third-party (Irregular) safety eval, joining Anthropic and OpenAI; OpenAI published an on-record response citing 'intentionally reduced safeguards.' Pattern now spans three labs via the same evaluator in at least two cases.
stories.score_note: Third distinct disclosure in the same story arc within two weeks.

stories.headline: Kushner, Mladenov and Blair to press Netanyahu on Gaza disarmament next week
stories.one_line: Jared Kushner will travel to Israel and Egypt next week with Board of Peace envoy Nikolay Mladenov and Tony Blair to press the disarmament roadmap, the first concrete US diplomatic follow-through since Netanyahu's Aug 9 rejection of the 15-point sequencing. Netanyahu continues rejecting phased-withdrawal-for-phased-disarmament; Hamas (Ghazi Hamad) says it won't disarm until Israel halts strikes/increases aid/pulls back. A reported Hamas demand that weapons go to Palestinian (not Israeli) custody is single-reliable-sourced.
stories.score_note: First concrete diplomatic follow-through step; watch the Kushner trip next week.

stories.headline: Novo Nordisk hit with a third analyst downgrade (UBS, Buy to Neutral) following last week's failed cardiovascular trial
stories.one_line: UBS cut NVO from Buy to Neutral today (Aug 5), following Wall Street Zen (Aug 2, Buy to Hold) and HSBC (Jul 31, Strong Buy to Hold). Some analysts (Jefferies, Citi) view the stock's reaction to the ZEUS trial failure as oversized relative to ziltivekimab's actual revenue contribution. Related HERMES/ARTEMIS ziltivekimab trials continue, readouts expected H1 2027.
stories.score_note: Third consecutive downgrade; no confirmation yet of whether the market reaction was overdone.

stories.headline: Coinbase posts a third straight quarterly loss as revenue falls 14%
stories.one_line: Q2 revenue $1.22B (-14% Y/Y), net loss $359.5M, third consecutive quarterly loss. Shares closed -9.27% (this run's data), this run's sharpest financials-watchlist decliner. Forecast 2026-07-31-pm-3 logged (at least one sell-side price-target cut within 5 sessions, 55-65%).
stories.score_note: Sharpest single-name financials decline this run; no clear read-through to broader crypto-asset prices identified.
sources: Coinbase Q2 2026 report (primary, via wire coverage)

stories.headline: NDAA FY2027 remains blocked in the Senate; no procedural movement since the Jul 14 cloture failure
stories.one_line: No procedural movement since the Jul 14 cloture failure. Duckworth's position unchanged. Published Senate floor schedules show Monday's floor focus is a continuing-resolution/funding cloture vote (H.R. 6500) and Medicaid hearings, not NDAA -- suggesting no floor action is currently teed up before the Aug 10 recess, though no outlet has explicitly confirmed either way. Dropped from Top Stories this cycle (no material change), retained on watchlist.
stories.score_note: No material change this week beyond confirming the procedural standstill continues.

stories.headline: Two firefighting helicopters collide over Greece's wildfire front, killing two crew members
stories.one_line: Two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air near Psatha, west of Athens, Sunday while battling the Attica fire front. Both crew of one aircraft (a Danish pilot, a Greek coordinator) were killed; the second aircraft's crew (British pilot, Greek liaison) survived with injuries. Greece separately saw ~60 new fire ignitions in a single day (Aug 1); a Porto Germeno blaze damaged up to 150 homes and required a seaborne rescue. Spain's megafires downgraded but new flare-ups hit Leon/Caceres; France's Bordeaux-area burn scar remains contained; Turkey's fire front shifted to the Aegean/Mediterranean coasts. EU's rescEU fleet (its largest deployment on record) remains active across 12 countries.
stories.score_note: First aviation fatalities of this summer's European wildfire season.

stories.headline: Ceuta's own local government leader now testifies the death toll reached 100, a fifth distinct figure
stories.verification: Confirmed (testimony/report occurred); Disputed (which figure is authoritative)
stories.one_line: NGO Caminando Fronteras now reports 141 dead (78 Spanish waters, 63 Moroccan territory) via morgue-monitoring methodology -- a sixth distinct figure, above Wednesday's 100 (local-official EU Parliament testimony) and the 67-88 government range. Forecast 2026-08-03-pm-3 continues trending wrong.
stories.score_note: Range now spans 67-141 across all tracked sources.

stories.headline: Spokane-area wildfire complex reaches first containment as some evacuations ease
stories.one_line: Containment holds at 13% across all three fires (Old Trails, Autumn Lane, Fairview per this morning's read); no material change found this run beyond the previously reported evacuation easing.
stories.score_note: No new development this run.

stories.headline: Indonesian ferry fire: missing-passenger count now explicitly uncertain, not settled at 41
stories.one_line: Officials say the Mutiara Sentosa 2's manifest (271 listed) undercounted actual passengers aboard, making the previously reported '41 missing' figure explicitly uncertain rather than settled. 229 rescued, 5 bodies recovered as of the most recent reporting; search area extends 10nm east/west, expected to run at least seven days total.
stories.score_note: Uncertainty about the true missing count is itself the new development.

stories.headline: Palantir's 93%-revenue-growth Q2 sparks the day's largest single-name move and a market-wide AI-software rally
stories.one_line: Q2 adjusted EPS $0.41 (vs $0.35 est.), revenue $1.935B (+93% Y/Y, vs $1.8B est.); US commercial revenue +149% to $764M. FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $8.150-8.158B. CEO Karp called it 'otherworldly.' Stock closed +29.5%, the watchlist's largest mover today and a lead driver of the broader risk-on tape alongside falling oil and JOLTS.
stories.score_note: Single largest market mover this run; reinforces the AI-infrastructure demand narrative into AMD/SpaceX earnings.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance fetch

stories.headline: Chipotle's 8-K content confirmed directly from EDGAR: MN health dept has 'no ongoing concerns'; jalapenos identified as common ingredient
stories.one_line: This run fetched and read Chipotle's Aug 4 8-K (Item 7.01) directly from SEC EDGAR: FDA/MN Dept of Health investigating; MN DOH 'confirmed it has no ongoing concerns with Chipotle'; jalapenos identified via traceability system as a potential common ingredient from a common lot, proactively removed. Resolves last night's 'content unconfirmed' flag. Two lawsuits filed Aug 5. Case count steady at 110 as of last check. CMG closed -2.29% today.
stories.score_note: Resolves the prior content-unconfirmed gap; not logged as a corrections.json entry since no prior published statement was inaccurate, only incomplete.

stories.headline: Trump says he hasn't discussed Fauci prosecution with Blanche or Pirro; DOJ still reviewing the contempt referral
stories.one_line: Trump told reporters Aug 10-11 (per Semafor's Shelby Talcott) he has 'not spoken' to AG Blanche or DC US Attorney Pirro about prosecuting Fauci, tempering earlier suggestions Fauci could face Bannon/Navarro-style contempt charges. DOJ says it is 'reviewing' the Aug 6 referral; no charging decision announced.
stories.score_note: First real test of how the Blanche DOJ handles the referral; Trump's statement is a data point, not a signal of the eventual decision either way.

stories.headline: Fighting resumes in western Tigray, most serious escalation since the 2022 Pretoria peace deal
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (fact of fighting); casualty figures unavailable
stories.one_line: A TPLF-affiliated source describes a de-escalation this week following the Aug 1-2 Shererina clashes, though this is single-sourced and not independently confirmed by the Ethiopian federal government. Both sides continue to blame the other for initiating the fighting; Amnesty International separately warns of renewed human-rights-violation risk to Tigray residents regardless of the immediate military trajectory.
stories.score_note: Tentative de-escalation; forecast 2026-08-07-am-3 (containment within 14 days, window to ~Aug 15) trending correct but not yet resolved.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan sign a NATO-style mutual defense pact
stories.one_line: Analysts (Jerusalem Post via Tribune India, France 24, Atlantic Council) say the pact failed its first practical test: neither Turkiye nor Pakistan issued any collective-defense response to Saturday's Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery. No formal Saudi request for pact invocation has been reported.
stories.score_note: Partial answer only; watch for a Saudi or Turkish statement explicitly addressing pact applicability.

stories.headline: Trump signs executive order directing 90-day review of childhood vaccine schedule, recommending MMR split into three doses
stories.one_line: AAP President Dr. Andrew Racine called the Aug 10 EO "disheartening and dangerous"; AMA also criticized it. Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA, a physician) publicly broke with the administration: "This executive order is wrong... Vaccines DO NOT cause autism." NY Gov. Hochul signed a counter-EO expanding COVID-vaccine access. No new lawsuit specifically targeting the Aug 10 order found yet; existing AAP v. HHS litigation (Jan 2026 schedule change) remains a separate, stayed matter.
stories.score_note: Sustained multi-day story confirmed by the speed and breadth of medical/political reaction, including a same-party physician-senator's public break.

stories.headline: NVDA falls ~2.3% on FT report of $500B Wall Street-backed AI-infrastructure financing venture
stories.one_line: Second-day fallout: named platform partners KKR (+6.84%) and Apollo (+6.46%) plus Blackstone (+3.56%) posted their strongest session tracked this cycle; Ares (+4.70%, not a named partner) rallied in apparent sympathy. This run's own EDGAR check found no Apollo-specific catalyst (a routine Reg FD filing only), reinforcing the Nvidia-platform read.
stories.score_note: Today's move is this report's largest confirmed-catalyst market move; forecast 2026-08-11-pm-2 logged on whether it partially reverts.

stories.headline: China's Long March 7A explodes after liftoff, fourth orbital launch failure of 2026
stories.one_line: Long March 7A carrying ChinaSat-4B broke apart ~83-85s after an 8:02 AM ET Wenchang liftoff, during the joint first-stage/booster burn; rocket and payload lost over the South China Sea. Xinhua confirmed the failure ("anomaly under investigation"); independently corroborated by SpaceNews, SCMP, Space.com, Aviation Week, NASASpaceFlight. China's 4th failure of 56 launch attempts in 2026.
stories.score_note: No CASC statement located yet; watch for the investigation finding.

stories.headline: Colombia earthquake toll revised up again to 281 dead
stories.one_line: President de la Espriella cited 281 dead, 3,971 injured, 379 missing as of Aug 13 -- a fifth distinct upward revision since Aug 10 (181 -> 224 -> 250/265 -> 273 -> 281). Resolves forecast 2026-08-13-am-3 (UNGRD converges to within 20 of the presidential figure) as correct. More than 12,000 homes destroyed, 74,000+ damaged.
stories.score_note: Revision pattern continues; watch whether 281 finally holds.

stories.headline: Space-sector earnings season: Spire beats on EPS but misses on revenue; Intuitive Machines and York Space Systems report today
stories.one_line: Spire Global (SPIR) reported Q2 2026 after Tuesday's (Aug 12) close: EPS -$0.31 beat vs. -$0.33 estimate, revenue $18.04M missed vs. $18.53M estimate; FY26 guidance roughly in line at the midpoint. SPIR closed Wednesday -0.54%, a muted reaction. Intuitive Machines (LUNR) reports before today's (Aug 13) open (options imply ~13.5% move); York Space Systems (YSS) reports after tonight's close. Broader space-sector session was strong Wednesday ahead of both: BKSY +6.62%, YSS +4.15%, ASTS +3.74%, PL +3.38%, VSAT +3.21%, LUNR +2.85%.
stories.score_note: Three space-earnings prints in three sessions; sector momentum going in has been real but results themselves are mixed so far.
sources: AST SpaceMobile earnings call transcript via Investing.com

stories.headline: Anthropic, Macquarie and GIC form Theseus Infrastructure to build dedicated US AI data centers
stories.one_line: New joint venture to develop/lease purpose-built US data centers to Anthropic under long-term contracts; Macquarie and GIC provide majority equity, Anthropic covers consumer electricity-rate increases from construction/operation. Size, sites, and timeline not detailed in sources reviewed.
stories.score_note: Same-week second major AI-infrastructure financing disclosure alongside Nvidia's $500B platform; reported with the same neutral standard applied to any company despite Anthropic building this system.

stories.headline: KKR, Apollo, Ares and Blackstone give back part of their two-day Nvidia-financing rally -- the group's first down session since the story broke
stories.one_line: After Wednesday's first down session since the Nvidia-financing story broke, all four rebounded sharply Thursday: Ares +4.96%, KKR +4.00%, Apollo +3.57%, Blackstone +2.00% (this run's own data), more than erasing Wednesday's pullback for three of the four names. No company-specific catalyst found; this run's own EDGAR sweep again came up empty.
stories.score_note: Wednesday's dip now reads as ordinary profit-taking rather than a reversal, given today's rebound.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data and Yahoo Finance close-series data
SEC EDGAR (primary, this run's own check)

stories.headline: Oil's Hormuz-driven rally pushes the 10-year yield toward cycle highs, reviving a live Fed hike-vs-cut debate before CPI
stories.one_line: WTI +1.64% today (this run's data), wire coverage puts the week's cumulative gain above 6%, after a senior Iranian official reiterated Hormuz will not reopen until the US unfreezes Iranian funds. 10Y yield (^TNX) 4.684%, near its highest since January per wire coverage. Today's $58B 3-year Note auction was solid-not-exceptional (high yield 4.291%, bid-to-cover 2.71). Multiple outlets now describe September hike-vs-cut odds as roughly 50/50.
stories.score_note: Raises the stakes on tomorrow's CPI energy/gasoline subcomponent specifically; forecast 2026-08-11-pm-1 logged.
sources: this run's own FRED and Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: Musk discloses a 48.4% SpaceX stake worth ~$900B, six days before the Aug 20 unlock
stories.one_line: A regulatory filing disclosed Musk holds 6.42B SpaceX shares (48.4% economic stake, >82% voting power), valued at ~$900-907B. Musk said on X a large portion vests only on "extremely crazy good outcomes." SPCX closed Thursday -3.33% at $141.29, still up ~21% since the first insider tranche cleared Aug 6 without a selloff.
stories.score_note: Disclosure lands right before the next concrete unlock catalyst (Aug 20, ~320M shares).

stories.headline: SpaceX reverses sharply, +9.3%, on CEO Musk's AI-revenue remarks -- snapping three straight down sessions tied to the Aug 20 unlock
stories.one_line: SPCX closed +9.30% at $145.69 today (this run's own data), its best session in weeks, reversing the three-session unlock-related slide (Aug 10-11). Multiple outlets (Invezz, Benzinga, TradingKey) attribute the move to CEO Elon Musk's internal all-hands remarks that AI-related revenue would 'definitely' exceed all other revenue streams within a month. No SpaceX press release or filing corroborates the specific timeline -- treated as management commentary, not disclosed guidance.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-11-pm-3 (continued weakness into Aug 20) now tracking wrong pending Saturday's grading; forecast 2026-08-12-pm-2 logged on whether today's gain holds through the unlock.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data/Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: Home Depot falls 2.9% after CEO Ted Decker takes temporary medical leave; two executives named to oversee operations
stories.one_line: Chair/President/CEO Edward P. Decker is taking a medical leave expected to last a few months; condition undisclosed. Ann-Marie Campbell (SEVP) named to oversee day-to-day operations, Richard V. McPhail (EVP/CFO) named interim principal executive officer. Confirmed via HD's own 8-K (Items 5.02/7.01/9.01, filed 09:06 ET, this run's own EDGAR sweep) and IR press release; independently corroborated by Bloomberg. HD closed -2.89%, the clearest single-name driver of Consumer Discretionary's sector-wide underperformance today.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 logged on whether HD falls a further 3%+ over the next 5 sessions.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data close-series data

stories.headline: Mega-cap tech splits sharply: AI-infrastructure/semiconductor names rally while Microsoft, Meta, Apple and Tesla fall
stories.one_line: Micron +5.92%, Arista +5.90%, Marvell +3.62%, Digital Realty +3.14%, Nvidia +2.32% rallied while Microsoft -2.07%, Meta -2.94%, Apple -1.26%, Tesla -1.67% fell (this run's own data). XLK +1.28% (best sector), XLC -0.75%/XLY -0.86% (weak sectors). Secondary sources report AI-cloud providers Nebius (+16-18%) and CoreWeave (+18%, not on this report's watchlist) also rallied on Q2 beats, treated as corroborating evidence for an AI-infrastructure-specific rally rather than a broad tech move. No single confirmed catalyst.
stories.score_note: New thread distinct from the Alphabet/DeepMind story; watch whether the AI-infra/software split persists.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data and Yahoo Finance close-series data

stories.headline: Ceva Logistics breach widens to include Ajax and ING; De Bijenkorf warns of month-long delivery delays
stories.one_line: De Bijenkorf warned Aug 13 that new orders won't ship until Sept 4. Affected downstream customers now include football club Ajax and banking group ING (shipping data only), beyond Bol/De Bijenkorf/Ace & Tate. No payment/credential data confirmed compromised.
stories.score_note: Real, disclosed operational impact continues to widen.

stories.headline: Ukraine hits a fourth Russian refinery in three days; Russia and Ukraine trade port and city strikes
stories.one_line: Ukrainian drones struck the Lukoil Volgograd refinery overnight (4th Russian refinery hit in 3 days, ~5.6% of national refining capacity). Russia hit Kramatorsk Thursday evening (8 FAB-250 bombs, 1 killed/17 injured) and Izmail Danube grain port overnight Aug 12-13 (Romania briefly scrambled jets). Zelensky says Ukraine has only ~1% of the Patriot interceptors it needs. A Ukrainian-sourced "double-tap on rescuers" claim is single-source, not independently confirmed.
stories.score_note: Refinery campaign now a sustained, escalating pressure track distinct from front-line fighting.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab clears major Iridium-acquisition milestones and replaces its $1.94B ATM equity program -- but the stock closes lower
stories.one_line: This run's own SEC EDGAR sweep found two RKLB 8-Ks today: HSR antitrust clearance for the Iridium acquisition (expired 11:59pm ET Aug 12), Form S-4 filed, FCC applications filed Aug 10; and a replacement (not increased) $1,944,369,826 ATM equity program to help fund the deal. RKLB closed -1.32% despite the objectively positive regulatory news -- a gap this report attributes to a likely, unconfirmed dilution-overhang read. Forecast 2026-08-13-pm-1 logged.
stories.score_note: New M&A/financing thread with strong primary sourcing; watch for the S-4 becoming effective.
sources: SEC EDGAR (primary, this run's own fetch)

stories.headline: Intuitive Machines swings from a ~16% premarket earnings plunge to a positive close
stories.one_line: LUNR missed on revenue ($206.2M vs ~$216.3M est.) and EPS (~-$0.16 vs ~-$0.09 est.), plunging to a premarket low of $14.29 (-15.7% vs Wednesday's close) by 9:25am ET, then recovered steadily through the session to close +3.60% at $17.56 -- this run's own minute-by-minute Yahoo Finance data. Record backlog ($1.76-1.8B) and reiterated FY26 guidance appear to have outweighed the headline miss once digested.
stories.score_note: Unusually large intraday round-trip; York Space Systems reports tonight, rounding out the week's space earnings.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance intraday data

stories.headline: July PPI flat on the headline but core producer-price inflation quadruples its pace to +0.4%
stories.one_line: BLS (direct fetch): headline PPI 0.0% m/m/+4.7% y/y; core (ex food/energy/trade services) +0.4% m/m/+4.7% y/y. Energy (-3.1%) and goods (-0.9%) offset services (+0.2%) and construction (+2.2%). Markets read it net-dovish (10Y yield -4bp to 4.641%, indices closed higher for a 2nd session) despite the hotter core print. Forecast 2026-08-13-pm-3 logged on Fed commentary before Jackson Hole.
stories.score_note: Headline-vs-core divergence is the notable nuance; a potential complication for the Warsh-hawkish-vs-jobs-dovish tension if it persists.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down by end of August
stories.one_line: Trump announced Aug 12 that Leavitt will leave the press secretary post by end of August to become a "top outside advisor" on midterm strategy. No successor named; White House signals a pick may not come until after the midterms. Replacement speculation (Habba, Kelly, McLaughlin) is explicitly Unverified.
stories.score_note: Notable staff departure with no successor yet named.

stories.headline: York Space Systems misses EPS and cuts FY26 guidance by roughly a third; shares plunge ~23% after-hours
stories.one_line: YSS Q2 revenue $92.5M (+10% Y/Y, narrow beat) but EPS -$0.21 missed -$0.16 est; FY26 revenue guidance cut to $375-405M citing delayed government contracts. Shares fell ~23% after-hours to ~$8.86, immediately after Thursday's regular-session +4.26% close -- the clearest earnings casualty of this week's three-report space-earnings arc.
stories.score_note: Sharpest single-name reaction of this week's space-earnings season; watch today's open.

stories.headline: VMware vCenter flaw CVE-2026-59310 confirmed under active exploitation -- 361+ victims across 47 countries
stories.one_line: The directory-traversal flaw (CVSS 9.8, disclosed Jul 29) is confirmed under active exploitation since Aug 3, with 361+ victim IPs across 47 countries and reverse-SSH cron persistence. Still absent from the CISA KEV catalog as of the Aug 11 bulletin, the most recent this report could verify (direct cisa.gov fetch blocked again this run).
stories.score_note: Status upgrade from unconfirmed to wide-scale confirmed exploitation; watch for a KEV listing.

stories.headline: Landslide floods a hydroelectric tunnel in India's Chamoli district; casualty count unsettled
stories.one_line: A landslide sent debris/water into the under-construction Vishnugad-Pipalkoti hydroelectric tail-race tunnel (Uttarakhand) Aug 13 evening. At least 6-7 dead confirmed via AP wire; trapped/missing count has fluctuated wildly hour to hour across outlets (28 trapped/22 working/12 rescued down to 3-4 missing in later updates) -- treated as explicitly unstable, not cited as a single figure.
stories.score_note: Fast-moving domestic disaster; expect further revision.
sources: Associated Press wire (via Washington Post, ABC News)
